name: com.noisemaker.hlsl
description: Noisemaker for Unity renders live procedural textures from the Noisemaker Polymorphic DSL via HLSL. A parallel port of the Noisemaker shader engine, graded against the reference engine's WebGL2 output: each parity case is byte-exact, within 1 per 8-bit channel (2 in the 3D corpora), or within its measured case-specific NEAR bound. Usable as a standalone renderer or as Shader Graph (material) building blocks.

samples.description: Render a bundled Noisemaker graph to a RenderTexture and display it on a material.
